groups.name: sequence
groups.description: Sequence diagrams of calls, transactions and SQL.

properties.name: sequence.enabled
properties.description: Turns the whole thing off when false.

properties.name: sequence.base-packages
properties.description: Whose beans become participants. Default: the package of your @SpringBootApplication.

properties.name: sequence.output-dir
properties.description: Where the .svg/.puml files and index.html are written.

properties.name: sequence.show-connections
properties.description: Draw taking a JDBC connection from the pool and giving it back.

properties.name: sequence.keep-in-memory
properties.description: How many diagrams the /sequence page remembers.

properties.name: sequence.max-label-length
properties.description: Longer SQL is cut with an ellipsis.

properties.name: sequence.http.enabled
properties.description: A diagram per HTTP request, and the live page at /sequence.

properties.name: sequence.http.excluded-paths
properties.description: Requests whose path starts with one of these are not drawn.
